subject.title: feat: retain iMessage tombstones and revisions

question: Should ordinary `imsgcrawl sync` change existing archives from replacement semantics to merge-and-retain semantics, with `--restore` becoming the only replacement path?
rationale: This is a user-visible, persistent archive contract change whose compatibility tradeoff cannot be resolved from tests alone.

options.title: Keep replacement as the default
options.body: Retain the current replacement behavior for ordinary sync and expose merge retention only through an explicit opt-in path.

options.title: Approve merge by default
options.body: Adopt merge-and-retain as the default only after maintainers accept the upgrade behavior and the PR adds inspectable redacted proof for fresh and upgraded archives.

options.title: Split the retention work
options.body: Land tombstone and revision support separately while deferring the default sync-semantics change to a focused product decision.

recommendation.title: Keep replacement as the default
recommendation.body: Retain the current replacement behavior for ordinary sync and expose merge retention only through an explicit opt-in path.

likelyOwner.reason: The choice determines the repository's persisted archive and CLI compatibility contract.
